what.en: Each location where taxable sales will be made: its actual street address, not a P.O. box. A Certificate of Authority is issued for each location and must be displayed there.
what.zh: 每个将进行应税销售的地点的实际街道地址，不得用邮政信箱。每个地点会单独发一张销售税授权证书，须在该处张贴。

ifNone.en: Use the store's own street address from the lease, and don't start selling there before its Certificate of Authority arrives. Only a show vendor or cart with no fixed place uses an owner's home address.
ifNone.zh: 填写租约上门店自己的街道地址；收到该地点的授权证书前不得开始销售。只有没有固定场所的展会摊贩或流动推车才可填业主住址。

confirmations.quote: Line 5 – Physical address – Enter the actual street address of your business. Do not enter a PO box number.
Do not begin business at the new location until you receive your sales tax Certificate of Authority for that location.
If you have more than one place of business, you must display a Certificate of Authority at each place of business.

notes: DTF-17-ATT (1/24), DTF-17-I (2/24) and Publication 750. The schedule has no box for the mailing address or the responsible person's address (it prints only their name and title), so neither is covered here; the DTF-17 itself is filed online.
